title: From Seeing to Thinking: Decoupling Perception and Reasoning Improves Post-Training of Vision-Language Models
comment: 19 pages, 9 figures; Accepted to ICML 2026; Project Page: https://ucsc-vlaa.github.io/VLM-CapCurriculum/
summary: Recent advances in vision-language models (VLMs) emphasize long chain-of-thought reasoning; yet, we find that their performance on visual tasks is primarily limited by a lack of visual perception as opposed to reasoning itself. In this work, we systematically study the interplay between perception and reasoning in VLM post-training by decomposing their capabilities into three separate training stages: visual perception, visual reasoning, and textual reasoning, incorporating specialized training data. We demonstrate that visual perception (a) requires targeted optimization with specialized data; (b) serves as a fundamental scaffold that should be solidified through staged training before refining visual reasoning; and (c) is more effectively learned via RL than caption-based SFT. Our experiments across multiple VLMs demonstrate that staged training consistently improves both visual perception and reasoning performance over merged training. Notably, models trained with our approach achieve 1.5% higher reasoning accuracy with 20.8% shorter reasoning traces, suggesting that superior perception reduces the need for excessive reasoning. Furthermore, we show that this capability-based staging represents a new curriculum dimension orthogonal to traditional difficulty-based curricula, and combining both yields further additive gains. Our staged-training models achieve superior performance among open-weight VLMs, establishing advanced results on several visual math and perception (e.g., +5.2% on WeMath and +3.7% on RealWorldQA) tasks compared with the base counterpart.

AI.tldr: 本文发现视觉语言模型（VLM）的性能瓶颈主要在于视觉感知而非推理能力，并提出分阶段训练策略（视觉感知→视觉推理→文本推理），通过专门的训练数据和强化学习（RL）优化感知，显著提升推理准确率（+1.5%）并缩短推理链（-20.8%）。
AI.motivation: 当前VLM研究聚焦于长链思维推理，但作者发现模型在视觉任务上的表现实际上受限于视觉感知能力而非推理本身，因此需要系统研究感知与推理在VLM后训练中的相互作用。
AI.method: 将VLM能力分解为视觉感知、视觉推理、文本推理三个阶段，分别使用专门训练数据进行分阶段训练；其中视觉感知采用强化学习（RL）优于基于标题的监督微调（SFT）。
AI.result: 分阶段训练持续优于混合训练；推理准确率提升1.5%，推理链长度缩短20.8%；在WeMath和RealWorldQA上分别提升5.2%和3.7%。
AI.conclusion: 视觉感知是基础性能力，需通过分阶段训练先固化；强化学习比SFT更有效；该能力维度的课程学习与传统的难度维度课程正交，两者结合可产生叠加增益。

title: Probing Embodied LLMs: When Higher Observation Fidelity Hurts Problem Solving
comment: Submitted to From Animals to Animats: The 18th International Conference on the Simulation of Adaptive Behavior (SAB)
summary: Large Language Models are increasingly proposed as cognitive components for robotic systems, yet their opaque decision processes make it difficult to explain success or failure in closed-loop embodied tasks. Following an empirical AI methodology, we study embodied LLM agents behaviorally by varying the information available to the agent and measuring the resulting changes in behavior. Using the Lockbox, a sequential mechanical puzzle with hidden interdependencies, we evaluate LLMs across RGB, RGB-D, and ground-truth symbolic observations in a physical robotic setup and use controlled simulation to probe the resulting behavior. Counterintuitively, agents perform best under raw RGB input and worst under perfect ground-truth observations. In simulation, we probe this effect by randomly flipping perceived action outcomes and find that moderate noise improves performance, peaking at a 40% flip probability with a 2.85-fold success rate increase over the noise-free baseline. Further analysis links this gain to a reduction in repetitive action loops. These findings suggest that success rates alone are insufficient for evaluating LLMs, as measured performance may reflect the interaction between perceptual errors and reasoning failures rather than robust problem solving.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过实体机器人实验和仿真控制，发现LLM在闭环具身任务中，使用原始RGB输入时表现最佳，而完美符号观测反而最差；引入适度噪声（40%动作结果翻转）可使成功率提升2.85倍，这得益于减少了重复动作循环。
AI.motivation: LLM被越来越多地用作机器人系统的认知组件，但其决策过程不透明，难以解释在闭环具身任务中的成败原因。因此，研究者希望采用经验性AI方法论，通过行为学方式研究LLM具身代理。
AI.method: 使用Lockbox（一个具有隐藏依赖关系的顺序机械谜题）作为评估任务，在物理机器人平台上测试LLM在RGB、RGB-D和地面真实符号观测三种条件下的表现。随后在仿真中通过随机翻转感知到的动作结果来探测行为变化。
AI.result: 原始RGB输入下表现最佳，完美地面真实观测下最差。仿真中，引入随机噪声（翻转动作结果）能提升性能，在40%翻转概率时达到峰值，成功率比无噪声基线提升2.85倍。性能提升与重复动作循环的减少相关。
AI.conclusion: 仅用成功率评估LLM是不充分的，因为测得的性能可能反映的是感知错误与推理失败的交互作用，而非稳健的问题解决能力。

title: UniRefiner: Teaching Pre-trained ViTs to Self-Dispose Dross via Contrastive Register
summary: Representation learning with Vision Transformers (ViTs) has advanced rapidly, yet the utility of large-scale models in spatially sensitive tasks is hindered by spurious tokens. Prior efforts to mitigate this have been limited, often defining these artifacts narrowly, for example, as simple high-norm outliers. We argue that this scope is insufficient. For dense prediction tasks, we posit that any token failing to encode location-aligned semantics should be treated as a spurious artifact. This broader definition reveals a more complex problem, leading us to systematically categorize and characterize three fundamental types of spurious tokens that corrupt spatial representations. Based on this comprehensive diagnosis, we propose UniRefiner, a universal refinement framework that teaches pre-trained ViTs to self-dispose of these artifacts. UniRefiner uses contrastive registers to explicitly isolate and redistribute spurious tokens via a dual objective: (i) it aligns image tokens with filtered regular tokens to preserve semantics, and (ii) it aligns register tokens with detected spurious tokens to capture the spurious signals. Our method requires only a few epochs of fine-tuning on ~5k images to refine diverse ViTs, including massive models like EVA-CLIP-8B and InternViT-6B. Experiments demonstrate consistent and significant improvements: notably, the refined EVA-CLIP-8B achieves 51.9\% mIoU on ADE20K (+9.4\%), surpassing specialized vision models like DINOv2 (49.1\%), while zero-shot segmentation accuracy improves by up to 22\%. UniRefiner unlocks the latent spatial potential of existing large-scale foundation models, paving the way for their broader application.

AI.tldr: 本文提出UniRefiner框架，通过对比寄存器机制识别并重构ViT中的三类伪影标记，仅需少量微调即可显著提升大模型在密集预测任务上的空间表征能力，在ADE20K上将EVA-CLIP-8B的mIoU提升9.4%至51.9%。
AI.motivation: 现有方法对ViT中伪影标记的定义过于狭窄（如仅视为高范数离群点），无法涵盖所有破坏空间语义的伪影，导致大模型在空间敏感任务中性能受限。
AI.method: 提出UniRefiner框架：（1）系统分类三种空间伪影标记类型；（2）采用对比寄存器机制，通过双目标优化——对齐图像标记与正常标记以保留语义，对齐寄存器标记与伪影标记以捕获伪影信号——实现伪影的隔离与重构。
AI.result: 在EVA-CLIP-8B和InternViT-6B等大规模模型上，仅需约5k图像微调数轮，ADE20K上mIoU达51.9%（+9.4%），超越DINOv2（49.1%）；零样本分割准确率提升高达22%。
AI.conclusion: UniRefiner有效释放了现有大规模基础模型的潜在空间能力，为将其更广泛地应用于密集预测任务铺平了道路。

title: TIDE: Efficient and Lossless MoE Diffusion LLM Inference with I/O-aware Expert Offload
summary: Diffusion Large Language Models (dLLMs) have emerged as a competitive alternative to autoregressive (AR) models, offering better hardware utilization and bidirectional context through parallel block-level decoding. However, as dLLMs continue to scale up with mixture-of-experts (MoE) architectures, their deployment on resource-constrained devices remains an open challenge. Existing AR-based methods often incur either prohibitive I/O overhead or significant compute bottlenecks. In this work, we propose TIDE, a novel resource-efficient inference system that leverages the temporal stability of expert activations during the diffusion process within the block. Specifically, we leverage the temporal stability of expert activations during the diffusion process within the block and introduce an interval-based expert refresh strategy that updates the expert placement in an I/O-aware fashion. To ensure optimal performance, we formulate the inference scheduling as a mathematical programming problem, solving for the optimal interval that minimizes I/O traffic and CPU computation. Most importantly, TIDE is a lossless optimization that requires no model training, providing a "free lunch" acceleration for dLLM inference. In a single GPU-CPU system, we demonstrate that TIDE achieves up to 1.4$\times$ and 1.5$\times$ throughput improvements over prior baselines on LLaDA2.0-mini and LLaDA2.0-flash models, respectively.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TIDE系统，利用扩散大语言模型中专家激活的时间稳定性，通过间隔式专家刷新策略和I/O感知调度，在不需训练的情况下实现1.4-1.5倍的推理加速。
AI.motivation: 扩散大语言模型（dLLM）在资源受限设备上的部署面临挑战，现有自回归方法存在I/O开销过大或计算瓶颈问题，亟需高效的推理系统。
AI.method: 利用块内扩散过程中专家激活的时间稳定性，提出间隔式专家刷新策略，并将推理调度建模为数学规划问题，求解最优间隔以最小化I/O流量和CPU计算。
AI.result: 在单GPU-CPU系统上，TIDE在LLaDA2.0-mini和LLaDA2.0-flash模型上分别实现1.4倍和1.5倍的吞吐量提升。
AI.conclusion: TIDE是一种无损优化方法，无需模型训练即可显著加速dLLM推理，为资源受限设备上的dLLM部署提供了有效方案。

title: Neurosymbolic Learning for Inference-Time Argumentation
summary: Claim verification is an important problem in high-stakes settings, including health and finance. When information underpinning claims is incomplete or conflicting, uncertain answers may be more appropriate than binary true or false classifications. In all cases, faithful explanations of the considerations determining the final verdict are crucial. We introduce inference-time argumentation (ITA), a trainable neurosymbolic framework for ternary claim verification in which a formal argumentation semantics giving the strength of claims is used both (i) to guide LLM training as models learn to generate arguments and assign them base scores (representing intrinsic strengths) and (ii) to compute ternary (true/false/uncertain) predictions from generated, scored arguments. As a result, at training time, argument generation and scoring can be optimised according to the quality of the induced argumentative predictions. Moreover, at inference time, the final prediction is faithful, by construction, to the arguments and scores determining the verdict, rather than being justified by a potentially unfaithful post-hoc reasoning trace as in conventional reasoning models. We finally show that, on two datasets for ternary claim verification, ITA improves upon argumentative baselines and can perform competitively against non-argumentative direct-prediction baselines, while providing verdicts that are computed deterministically from explicit, inspectable argumentative structures.

AI.tldr: 本文提出推理时论证（ITA）框架，将形式论证语义与LLM训练相结合，用于三值（真/假/不确定）声明验证，同时保证预测结果对生成论证的忠实性。
AI.motivation: 在健康和金融等高风险场景中，声明验证常面临信息不完整或冲突的情况，此时不确定答案比二元真假分类更合适，且需要忠实于推理过程的解释。现有方法缺乏对论证结构的显式建模，或依赖可能不忠实的后验推理链。
AI.method: ITA是一种可训练的神经符号框架，将形式论证语义用于两方面：(i) 指导LLM训练，让模型学习生成论证并分配基础分数；(ii) 根据生成的带分论证计算三值预测。训练时同步优化论证生成与评分，推理时预测由显式论证结构确定性计算得出。
AI.result: 在两个三值声明验证数据集上，ITA优于基于论证的基线方法，并能与非论证的直接预测基线竞争，同时提供由可检查的论证结构确定性计算得出的裁决。
AI.conclusion: ITA通过将形式论证语义嵌入LLM训练与推理过程，实现了可解释且忠实的三值声明验证，为高风险场景下的可信AI决策提供了有效范式。

title: PrAda: Few-Shot Visual Adaptation for Text-Prompted Segmentation
summary: Segmenting images is critical for visual understanding but demands extensive pixel-level annotations. Foundational models have enabled new paradigms for predicting new classes guided by textual prompts, without annotations from the target domain. Yet, on specialized target domains, far from the original pre-training, their performance degrades. We study the errors of existing methods under such domain-shift, finding that misclassification rather than mask generation is the main culprit. To address this, we introduce the novel problem of Few-Shot Visual Adaptation for text-prompted Segmentation. This kind of adaptation has been largely studied for image classification, but it remains unexplored for segmentation. We tackle this task with Prototype Adaptation (PrAda), a novel, parameter-efficient method that adapts a frozen text-prompted segmentation model. Our approach learns class-specific prototypes by combining fine-grained pixel features and high-level transformer representations, which are then fused with the original text-based predictions through a learned importance factor. This preserves the model's zero-shot potential while enabling strong adaptation to new domains. Experiments across semantic, instance, and panoptic segmentation on five benchmarks demonstrate that PrAda yields significant improvements over state-of-the-art and proposed baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PrAda方法，通过原型适配解决文本提示分割模型在领域迁移下分类错误严重的问题，在少样本场景下显著提升分割性能。
AI.motivation: 现有文本提示分割模型在目标域发生偏移时性能严重下降，研究发现主要问题在于分类错误而非掩码生成错误。同时，少样本视觉适配在图像分类领域已有大量研究，但在分割领域仍处于空白。
AI.method: 提出Prototype Adaptation (PrAda)方法：结合细粒度像素特征与高层Transformer表示学习类别原型，通过可学习的重要性因子将原型预测与原始文本预测融合，冻结原始模型参数，实现参数高效的领域适配。
AI.result: 在语义分割、实例分割、全景分割五个基准数据集上，PrAda显著优于现有最先进方法和所提出的基线方法。
AI.conclusion: PrAda在保持模型零样本能力的同时实现了对新领域的强适配，验证了原型适配在少样本分割任务中的有效性。

title: Using Aristotle API for AI-Assisted Theorem Proving in Lean 4: A Formalisation Case Study of the Grasshopper Problem
summary: AI-assisted theorem proving can now generate substantial Lean developments for olympiad-level mathematics, but the evidential status of such developments depends on which declarations are actually verified. This paper reports a Lean 4 formalization case study of an Aristotle API proof attempt for the Grasshopper problem, originally posed as IMO 2009 Problem 6. The generated artifact states a generalized Lean version of the theorem, contains four verified helper lemmas for local components of a maximality and adjacent-swap exchange strategy, and leaves the main theorem grasshopper closed directly by one unresolved sorry. The verified components establish that the final partial sum equals the total sum, that an adjacent transposition can affect only the relevant intermediate partial sum, that the changed partial sum has the expected form, and that maximality at a position admitting an adjacent successor swap forces a corresponding forbidden-set membership fact. The Aristotle output summary identifies the intended remaining mathematical step as the global counting step needed to show that these membership facts produce at least n distinct forbidden values, contradicting the cardinality assumption |M| < n; the Lean source itself does not reduce the main theorem to a separately encoded counting lemma. This case study gives an inspectable example of a central limitation in AI-assisted formalization, namely that local proof search can succeed while the global combinatorial bookkeeping required for a theorem remains unresolved. The paper contributes a reproducible Lean artifact and a precise analysis of its verified and unverified proof content.

AI.tldr: 本文通过Lean 4形式化验证了AI（Aristotle API）对IMO 2009第6题（Grasshopper问题）的证明尝试，发现AI成功验证了四个辅助引理，但主定理因全局计数步骤未解决而留有未完成部分（sorry），揭示了AI辅助定理证明中局部搜索成功但全局组合推理受限的现状。
AI.motivation: 探究AI辅助定理证明在奥林匹克级别数学问题上的可信度，特别是验证AI生成的证明中哪些部分真正可验证、哪些部分存在缺口。
AI.method: 对Aristotle API生成的Grasshopper问题证明进行Lean 4形式化案例研究，分析每个声明是否被实际验证，区分已验证引理与未完成的主定理。
AI.result: 四个辅助引理被成功验证（最终部分和等于总和、相邻对换仅影响相关中间部分和、改变后的部分和具有预期形式、最大性迫使禁止集成员关系），但主定理grasshopper因全局计数步骤未编码而留有sorry。
AI.conclusion: AI辅助形式化的核心限制在于：局部证明搜索可以成功，但全局组合簿记（如计数论证）仍无法自动完成，需要人工介入。

title: Not Every Rubric Teaches Equally: Policy-Aware Rubric Rewards for RLVR
summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards has made post-training highly effective when correctness can be checked automatically. However, many important model behaviors require satisfying several qualitative criteria at once. Rubric-based rewards address this setting by grading prompt-specific criteria and aggregating them into a scalar reward. Yet standard static aggregations conflate a criterion's human-assigned importance with its current usefulness as an optimization signal. We show that this assumption breaks down in rubric RL: many important criteria are already saturated or currently unreachable, while criteria that distinguish rollouts are not necessarily those with the largest human weights. We introduce POW3R, a policy-aware rubric reward framework that preserves human weights and category balance as the rubric objective while adapting criterion-level reward weights during training. POW3R uses rollout-level contrast to emphasize criteria that currently separate the policy's outputs, making the GRPO reward more informative without changing the underlying evaluation target. Across three base policies on two datasets spanning multimodal and text-only settings, POW3R wins $24$ of $30$ base-policy/metric comparisons, improving both mean rubric reward and strict completion (the fraction of prompts whose response satisfies every required rubric criterion) over vanilla GRPO with rubric rewards, and reaches the same plateau in $2.5$--$4\times$ fewer training steps. Rubric rewards should therefore distinguish what should matter in the final answer from what can teach the current policy.

AI.tldr: POW3R提出了一种策略感知的rubric奖励框架，通过自适应调整各评判标准的权重，使强化学习(GRPO)在多项定性标准同时优化时更高效，训练速度提升2.5-4倍，在30项对比中赢得24项。
AI.motivation: 现有的rubric奖励采用静态聚合方式（如固定权重），但这种方法混淆了"人类认为的重要性"与"当前对优化有用的信号"——许多重要标准已饱和或不可达，而能区分rollout的标准未必权重最大，导致优化效率低下。
AI.method: 提出POW3R框架：(1) 保留rubric目标中的人类权重和类别平衡；(2) 在训练过程中自适应调整各标准的奖励权重；(3) 利用rollout级别的对比，强调当前能区分策略输出的标准，使GRPO奖励更具信息性而不改变评估目标。
AI.result: 在三种基础策略、两个数据集（多模态和纯文本）上，POW3R在30项基础策略/指标对比中赢得24项，同时提升了平均rubric奖励和严格完成率（满足所有标准），训练步骤减少2.5-4倍。
AI.conclusion: Rubric奖励应该区分"最终答案中应关注什么"与"当前能教会策略什么"，即奖励权重的设计需考虑策略当前的学习状态，而非仅依赖人类的静态重要性判断。

title: P2DNav: Panorama-to-Downview Reasoning for Zero-shot Vision-and-Language Navigation
summary: Vision-and-language navigation (VLN) requires an embodied agent to ground natural-language instructions into executable navigation actions in unseen environments. Existing zero-shot methods typically rely on additional waypoint prediction modules, which often entangle high-level directional reasoning with fine-grained local grounding, leading to error-prone and unstable decisions. In this paper, we propose P2DNav, a hierarchical framework for zero-shot vision-and-language navigation. P2DNav consists of three core components: Panorama-to-Downview (P2D), Sliding-Window Dialogue Memory (SDM), and Reflective Reorientation Mechanism (RRM). P2D explicitly decomposes navigation decision-making into two stages: panoramic direction selection and downview local grounding. It first selects the instruction-relevant direction from a 360° panorama, and then predicts a pixel-level target point from the downview RGB observation in that direction. In addition, SDM organizes navigation history as a multi-turn dialogue context and maintains recent visual observations within a sliding window to support long-horizon navigation. RRM further enables reflective reorientation by assessing the reliability of local grounding based on the downview observation and returning to panoramic direction selection when necessary. Experiments on the R2R-CE benchmark show that P2DNav achieves strong performance among zero-shot methods. In particular, compared with the state-of-the-art (SOTA) zero-shot waypoint-based and waypoint-free methods, P2DNav achieves SR gains of 146.6% and 58.9%, respectively, demonstrating the effectiveness of P2D, SDM, and RRM for zero-shot VLN. Code will be released for public use.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种名为P2DNav的分层框架，用于零样本视觉与语言导航。它将导航决策分解为全景方向选择和下视局部定位两个阶段，结合滑动窗口对话记忆和反思性重定向机制，在R2R-CE基准上取得了显著优于现有零样本方法的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有零样本VLN方法通常依赖额外的路径点预测模块，将高层方向推理与细粒度局部定位耦合在一起，导致决策容易出错且不稳定。本文旨在通过层次化解耦来解决这一问题。
AI.method: 提出P2DNav框架，包含三个核心组件：(1) Panorama-to-Downview (P2D) 将决策分解为全景方向选择和下视局部定位两阶段；(2) Sliding-Window Dialogue Memory (SDM) 用多轮对话上下文组织导航历史并维护滑动窗口内的视觉观察；(3) Reflective Reorientation Mechanism (RRM) 评估局部定位的可靠性，必要时回退到全景方向选择。
AI.result: 在R2R-CE基准上，与SOTA零样本基于路径点的方法相比SR提升146.6%，与无路径点方法相比SR提升58.9%。
AI.conclusion: P2DNav通过层次化解耦设计，在零样本VLN任务中取得了显著性能提升，验证了P2D、SDM和RRM三个组件的有效性。

title: HaorFloodAlert: Deseasonalized ML Ensemble for 72-Hour Flood Prediction in Bangladesh Haor Wetlands
comment: 9 pages, 9 figures. To be submitted to raaicon.org
summary:
Flash floods in Bangladesh's haor wetlands show up with almost no warning. They wreck the annual boro rice harvest. Current setups, built for riverine floods, miss backwater dynamics entirely. These basins are flat. Water does not behave like it does on the Brahmaputra.
  We built HaorFloodAlert, a deseasonalized machine learning ensemble that forecasts 72-hour flood probability for the Sunamganj Haor (approximately 8,000 km2). Temperature was acting as a seasonal cheat code - it inflated accuracy by 6.9 pp just because floods happen in warm months. We caught that. We also built an upstream Barak River Sentinel-1 SAR proxy from Silchar, Assam, giving about 36 hours of lead time. Otsu-thresholded SAR change detection validates at 84-91 percent spatial match.
  The operational ensemble (RF 0.5625 + XGBoost 0.4375) hits 89.6 percent LOOCV accuracy, 87.5 percent recall, and 0.943 AUC-ROC on 77 real Sentinel-1 events. A three-tier alert pipeline and a BRRI-calibrated boro rice damage estimator are included.

AI.tldr: 针对孟加拉国haor湿地的突发洪水，开发了HaorFloodAlert机器学习集成模型，实现72小时洪水概率预报，LOOCV准确率89.6%，并包含三级预警管道和BRRI校准的boro水稻损失评估器。
AI.motivation: 孟加拉国haor湿地的山洪暴发几乎没有任何预警，严重破坏每年的boro水稻收割。现有系统是为河流洪水设计的，完全忽略了回水动力学，且这些盆地地势平坦，水流行为与布拉马普特拉河完全不同。
AI.method: 构建了去季节化的机器学习集成模型（RF 0.5625 + XGBoost 0.4375），利用上流Barak河Sentinel-1 SAR代理数据（约36小时提前量），采用Otsu阈值SAR变化检测（空间匹配84-91%），并发现温度是季节性作弊因素（膨胀准确率6.9个百分点）。
AI.result: 集成模型在77个真实Sentinel-1事件上达到89.6% LOOCV准确率、87.5%召回率和0.943 AUC-ROC，SAR变化检测空间匹配84-91%。
AI.conclusion: 该系统包含三级预警管道和BRRI校准的boro水稻损失评估器，为haor湿地提供了有效的洪水预警和农业损失评估方案。

title: Benchmarking and Evolving Reason-Reflect-Rectify for Reflective Visual Generation
summary: Text-to-Image (T2I) models and Unified Multimodal Models (UMMs) have achieved remarkable progress in visual generation. However, their reliance on a single-pass generation paradigm limits their ability to handle complex prompts requiring iterative refinement. To enable multi-round Reflective Visual Generation (RVG), we formalize the Reason-Reflect-Rectify (R^3) loop as a core framework and introduce R^3-Bench, a benchmark of over 600 expert-annotated instances that quantifies iterative reasoning and rectification capabilities. Evaluation on R^3-Bench reveals a critical gap: while state-of-the-art models can identify generation errors, they fail to generate actionable rectification instructions. To bridge this gap, we propose R^3-Refiner, a dual-stage framework leveraging Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) and a Hierarchical Reward Mechanism (HRM) to better align rectification with reflective reasoning. Experiments show that R^3-Refiner achieves significant improvements on R^3-Bench (+12.0% in Reflective Verdict Score, +9.0% in Rectification Score), and can be seamlessly integrated with various MLLMs to enhance the generation quality of different T2I models on GenEval++ and T2I-CompBench. Code is available at https://github.com/xiaomoguhz/R3-Bench.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了R^3循环框架用于多轮反思性视觉生成（RVG），构建了包含600+专家标注实例的R^3-Bench基准，并提出了R^3-Refiner双阶段框架（结合GRPO和层级奖励机制HRM），在基准上取得了显著提升。
AI.motivation: 现有文本到图像（T2I）模型和统一多模态模型（UMMs）虽然取得了显著进展，但单次生成范式限制了其处理需要迭代精化的复杂提示的能力。
AI.method: 形式化了Reason-Reflect-Rectify (R^3)循环框架；构建了R^3-Bench基准（600+专家标注实例）；提出R^3-Refiner双阶段框架，采用组相对策略优化（GRPO）和层级奖励机制（HRM）来更好地对齐修正与反思推理。
AI.result: 在R^3-Bench上，反思性判定分数提升12.0%，修正分数提升9.0%；在GenEval++和T2I-CompBench上也能提升不同T2I模型的生成质量。
AI.conclusion: R^3-Refiner能够有效弥合模型识别生成错误与生成可执行修正指令之间的差距，并可与多种多模态大语言模型无缝集成。

title: A Methodology for Selecting and Composing Runtime Architecture Patterns for Production LLM Agents
comment: 25 pages, 2 figures, 6 tables. Companion repo at https://github.com/vasundras/agent-runtime-patterns
summary:
Production LLM agents combine stochastic model outputs with deterministic software systems, yet the boundary between the two is rarely treated as a first-class architectural object. This paper names that boundary the stochastic-deterministic boundary (SDB): a four-part contract among a proposer, verifier, commit step, and reject signal that specifies how an LLM output becomes a system action. We argue that the SDB is the load-bearing primitive of production agent runtimes.
  Around this primitive, we organize agent runtime design into three concerns: Coordination, State, and Control. We present a catalog of six runtime patterns that compose the SDB differently across conversational, autonomous, and long-horizon agents: hierarchical delegation, scatter-gather plus saga, event-driven sequencing, shared state machine, supervisor plus gate, and human in the loop. For each pattern, we trace its lineage to distributed-systems concepts and identify what changes when the worker is stochastic.
  The paper contributes a five-step methodology for selecting runtime patterns, a diagnostic procedure that maps production failures to pattern weaknesses, and a failure mode called replay divergence, in which LLM-based consumers of a deterministic event log produce different downstream outputs under model-version or prompt changes. A stylized reliability decomposition separates per-call model variance from architectural momentum, motivating the claim that as model variance decreases, pattern choice and SDB strength become increasingly important levers for long-run reliability. We apply the methodology to five workloads and provide one runnable reference implementation for a 90-day contract-renewal agent.

AI.tldr: 本文提出**随机-确定性边界（SDB）**作为生产级LLM Agent的核心架构原语，并围绕它整理出六大运行时模式、一套模式选择方法论、故障诊断流程，以及一种名为“回放发散”的独特失效模式。
AI.motivation: 现有Agent系统将LLM随机输出与确定性软件系统简单拼接，但两者之间的边界从未被当作一等架构对象来系统研究，导致系统可靠性、可复现性和可运维性缺乏理论支撑。
AI.method: 1. 提出SDB四部分契约（提议者、验证者、提交步骤、拒绝信号）；2. 围绕协调、状态、控制三个维度组织运行时设计；3. 给出六种运行时模式（层级委托、散聚+Saga、事件驱动、共享状态机、监督+门控、人在回路）；4. 提供五步模式选择方法论和基于回放发散的失效诊断流程。
AI.result: 1. 将分布式系统概念映射到LLM Agent场景；2. 揭示“回放发散”失效模式——同一确定性事件日志在不同模型版本或提示变更下产生不同输出；3. 给出可靠性分解：单次调用模型方差 vs 架构动量，后者在模型方差降低时愈发重要；4. 应用于五个工作负载并提供一个90天合同续约Agent的可运行参考实现。
AI.conclusion: SDB是生产Agent系统的负载支撑原语，随着模型方差减小，模式选择和SDB强度将成为长期可靠性的关键杠杆。

title: CAD-Free Learning of Spacecraft Pose Estimators via NeRF-Based Augmentations
summary: Spacecraft pose estimation networks require tens of thousands of CAD-rendered images to be trained. This reliance on synthetic CAD data (i) limits applicability to targets with reliable geometry prior, excluding uncooperative or poorly documented spacecraft, and (ii) causes poor generalization to real on-orbit conditions due to unrealistic illumination and material appearance. This paper introduces a NeRF-based image augmentation method that enables the learning of spacecraft pose estimators from only a few tens to a few hundreds of images. The method learns a Neural Radiance Field of the target and generates a large, diverse dataset through geometrically-consistent viewpoint and appearance augmentation. This augmented dataset enables the training of accurate target-specific pose estimators without requiring a CAD model or large synthetic datasets. Experiments show that our approach supports the training of accurate pose estimators from only 25 to 400 realistic images, even under severe illumination variations. When applied on large CAD-based synthetic datasets, the NeRF-based augmentation also enhances out-of-domain generalization, yielding improved robustness to real on-orbit conditions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于NeRF的图像增强方法，仅需几十到几百张真实图像即可训练航天器位姿估计网络，无需CAD模型或大规模合成数据集。
AI.motivation: 现有航天器位姿估计网络依赖大量CAD渲染图像训练，这限制了其对缺乏可靠几何先验的非合作/记录不全航天器的适用性，且因光照和材质不真实导致在轨泛化能力差。
AI.method: 学习目标航天器的神经辐射场（NeRF），通过几何一致的视角和外观增强生成大规模多样化数据集，用于训练位姿估计器。
AI.result: 仅用25-400张真实图像即可训练准确位姿估计器；在大型CAD合成数据集上应用本方法也能提升域外泛化能力，增强对真实在轨条件的鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: NeRF图像增强有效减少了对CAD模型的依赖，实现了从少量真实图像学习高质量位姿估计，并提升了模型在真实场景中的泛化性能。

title: Cross-View Splatter: Feed-Forward View Synthesis with Georeferenced Images
comment: Submitted to CVPR 2026. 8 figures, 3 tables. Project page: https://nianticspatial.github.io/cross-view-splatter/
summary: We present Cross-View Splatter, a feed-forward method that predicts pixel-aligned Gaussian splats for outdoor scenes captured at ground level AND by satellite. Faithful reconstructions require good camera coverage, but ground imagery is time-consuming and hard to capture at scale for large outdoor scenes. Fortunately, satellite imagery can provide a global geometric prior that is easy to access via public APIs. Cross-View Splatter fuses orthorectified satellite views with GPS-tagged ground photos to predict Gaussian splats in a unified 3D coordinate frame. By aligning ground and bird's-eye feature representations, our model improves scene coverage and novel-view synthesis, compared to ground imagery alone. We train on curated georeferenced datasets and paired satellite-terrain data, mined from open mapping services. We evaluate our method on a new benchmark for novel-view synthesis with georeferenced imagery allowing comparison to prior state-of-the-art methods. Our code and data preparation will be available at https://nianticspatial.github.io/cross-view-splatter/.

AI.tldr: Cross-View Splatter是一种前馈方法，通过融合地面照片与卫星图像，生成像素对齐的高斯泼溅，用于户外场景的新视角合成，相比仅使用地面图像能显著提升场景覆盖率和重建质量。
AI.motivation: 地面图像采集耗时费力，难以大规模覆盖户外场景，而卫星图像易于获取且能提供全局几何先验。本工作旨在利用卫星图像的全局信息来弥补地面图像的覆盖不足，实现更高效、更完整的场景重建。
AI.method: 1) 融合正射校正后的卫星视图与GPS标记的地面照片；2) 在统一3D坐标框架中对齐地面和鸟瞰特征表示；3) 预测像素对齐的高斯泼溅；4) 在精选的地理参考数据集和配对卫星-地形数据上训练，数据来自开放地图服务。
AI.result: 相比仅使用地面图像的方法，该方法在场景覆盖率和新视角合成质量上均有提升。在新建的地理参考图像基准上进行了评估，与现有最先进方法进行了比较。
AI.conclusion: 结合卫星和地面视角的跨视角融合策略，能有效利用卫星图像的易得性和全局几何信息来补充地面图像，为大规模户外场景重建提供了一种实用的解决方案。

title: DocQT: Improving Document Forgery Localization Robustness via Diverse JPEG Quantization Tables
summary: Document manipulation localization models achieve strong performance on public benchmarks yet fail to generalize to operational document workflows. We identify a critical and overlooked source of this gap: the mismatch between the narrow distribution of JPEG quantization tables used during training -restricted to standard libjpeg quality factors -and the heterogeneous compression profiles encountered in real-world insurance document pipelines. To isolate this factor, we conduct a controlled factorial study comparing two architectures with contrasting levels of quantization table awareness -FFDN [2] and Mesorch [20] -each trained under either standard quality factor augmentation (Standard-QT ) or operationally calibrated quantization tables sampled from DocQT, a quantization-table bank derived from a MAIF operational image corpus (Real-QT ), and evaluated under three recompression conditions. Training under Real-QT yields substantial localization gains on DocTamper [15] and significantly reduces the pixel-level false positive rate on authentic operational documents, but only for architectures that explicitly ingest the quantization table as input. The released DocQT quantization-table dataset and compression-reproduction material are directly available at https://github.com/Kyliroco/Improving-Document-Forgery-Localization-Robustness-via-Diverse-JPEG-Quantization-Tables. These results demonstrate that standard quality factor augmentation does not adequately proxy operational compression diversity, and that architectural choices explicitly conditioning on the quantization table provide a meaningful robustness advantage for real-world deployment.

AI.tldr: 本文发现文档篡改定位模型在真实保险文档中泛化失败的关键原因是训练时JPEG量化表分布狭窄（仅用标准libjpeg质量因子）与真实场景中异构压缩配置的失配。通过引入真实量化表数据集DocQT训练，仅在显式输入量化表的架构上显著提升定位性能并降低误报率。
AI.motivation: 现有文档篡改定位模型在公开基准上表现优异，但在真实的保险文档处理流程中泛化能力不足。作者识别出这一差距的一个关键但被忽视的原因：训练时使用的JPEG量化表分布（仅限于标准libjpeg质量因子）与真实场景中的异构压缩配置之间存在严重不匹配。
AI.method: 采用受控因子实验设计，比较两种对量化表感知程度不同的架构（FFDN和Mesorch），分别在标准质量因子增强（Standard-QT）和从MAIF真实图像语料库采样的操作校准量化表（Real-QT）下训练，并在三种重新压缩条件下评估。
AI.result: 使用Real-QT训练在DocTamper数据集上取得显著定位性能提升，并在真实操作文档上大幅降低像素级误报率。但该提升仅出现在显式将量化表作为输入摄入的架构中。
AI.conclusion: 标准质量因子增强无法充分代理真实世界的压缩多样性，显式依赖量化表作为输入条件的架构设计为实际部署提供了有意义的鲁棒性优势。

title: FineBench: Benchmarking and Enhancing Vision-Language Models for Fine-grained Human Activity Understanding
comment: CVPR'26 (Workshop on Video Large Language Models)
summary: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have demonstrated remarkable capabilities in general video understanding, yet they often struggle with the fine-grained comprehension crucial for real-world applications requiring nuanced interpretation of human actions and interactions. While some recent human-centric benchmarks evaluate aspects of model behaviour such as fairness/ethics, emotion perception, and broader human-centric metrics, they do not combine long-form videos, very dense QA coverage, and frame-level spatial/temporal grounding at scale. To bridge this gap, we introduce FineBench, a human-centric video question answering (VQA) benchmark specifically designed to assess fine-grained understanding. FineBench comprises 199,420 multiple-choice QA pairs densely annotated across 64 long-form videos (15 minutes each), focusing on detailed person movement, person interaction, and object manipulation, including compositional actions. Our extensive evaluation reveals that while proprietary models like GPT-5 achieve respectable performance, current open-source VLMs significantly underperform, struggling particularly with spatial reasoning in multi-person scenes and distinguishing subtle differences in human movements and interactions. To address these identified weaknesses, we propose FineAgent, a modular framework that enhances VLMs by leveraging a Localizer and a Descriptor. Experiments show that FineAgent consistently improves the performance of various open VLMs on FineBench. FineBench provides a rigorous testbed for future research into fine-grained human-centric video understanding, while FineAgent offers a practical approach to enhance such reasoning in current VLMs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出FineBench（一个包含199,420个细粒度QA对、基于64段长视频的人类中心视频理解基准）和FineAgent（一个通过定位器与描述器模块提升开源VLM性能的框架），实验表明开源VLM在细粒度时空推理上显著落后于闭源模型，而FineAgent可有效提升其表现。
AI.motivation: 现有VLM在通用视频理解上表现良好，但在细粒度人类动作理解（如多人场景空间推理、细微动作差异辨别）上存在不足；同时现有基准未能同时覆盖长视频、密集QA标注和帧级时空定位，因此需要构建专门的细粒度人类中心视频理解基准。
AI.method: 1）构建FineBench：基于64段15分钟长视频，人工标注199,420个多选题QA对，覆盖人物运动、交互、物体操作及组合动作；2）提出FineAgent模块化框架，包含Localizer（定位关键帧/区域）和Descriptor（生成细粒度描述），以增强开源VLM的细粒度理解能力。
AI.result: 闭源模型（如GPT-5）在FineBench上表现较好，但开源VLM显著落后，尤其在多人场景空间推理和细微动作区分上；FineAgent在不同开源VLM上均能带来持续性能提升。
AI.conclusion: FineBench为细粒度人类中心视频理解提供了严格的测试平台，FineAgent为当前VLM增强此类推理能力提供了实用方案。

title: Physics-informed simulation framework for realistic sonar image generation and statistical validation
summary: Synthetic sonar datasets offer a scalable alternative to costly real-world acquisition, yet their utility remains limited by the absence of rigorous quantitative validation. We present ACOUSIM (ACOustic SIMulation and Validation Platform), a physics-informed framework that evaluates the statistical alignment between synthetic and real sonar imagery without relying on generative models. A Gazebo-based environment generates sonar-like images by explicitly controlling seabed texture, illumination-driven shadowing, platform altitude, and noise. Realism is quantified against two public sonar datasets, SeabedObjects-KLSG-II and Sonar Common Target Detection (SCTD), using global intensity and local texture (LBP) distributions assessed via Kullback-Leibler divergence, Jensen-Shannon divergence, and Earth Mover's Distance. Results show strong texture alignment (KL < 0.07) across all classes, with plane-class intensity alignment outperforming ship-class due to shadow geometry complexity. ACOUSIM establishes a reproducible, distribution-level baseline for sim-to-real sonar evaluation and directly supports reliable dataset validation for underwater image analysis.

AI.tldr: 提出了ACOUSIM框架，通过物理模拟和统计分布验证（KL散度<0.07）证明合成声纳图像与真实数据在纹理和强度分布上的高度对齐，为水下图像分析建立了可复现的模拟-真实评估基线。
AI.motivation: 合成声纳数据集虽可扩展但缺乏严格的定量验证，现有方法未系统评估模拟数据与真实数据的统计对齐程度。
AI.method: 基于Gazebo环境生成声纳图像，控制海床纹理、光照阴影、平台高度和噪声；使用KL散度、JS散度和Earth Mover's Distance对全局强度和局部LBP纹理分布进行统计对比验证。
AI.result: 纹理对齐表现优异（KL<0.07），平面类强度对齐优于船舶类（因阴影几何复杂性差异）。
AI.conclusion: ACOUSIM提供了可复现的分布级模拟-真实评估基线，可直接支持水下图像分析中的可靠数据集验证。

title: Physics-in-the-Loop: A Hybrid Agentic Architecture for Validated CAD Engineering Design
comment: Accepted in IJCAI-ECAI 2026 (Special Track on AI4Tech)
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) can generate Computer-Aided Design (CAD), yet lack physical comprehension required for reliable engineering design. Instead of attempting to implicitly learn physical laws from data, we propose a Hybrid Agentic-Physical Architecture that embeds validated knowledge-based engineering tools directly into the decision making loop of autonomous AI agents. In this framework, engineering design is formulated as a closed-loop, sequential decision making process guided by explicit physical verification. Based on a load case, dedicated agents iteratively plan, generate, evaluate, and revise engineering designs using knowledge-based tools as a feedback signal. We introduce a benchmark dataset and metrics for assessing functional validity in generative CAD. Our system generates more complex and physically verified designs, with a 4.2 increase in structural complexity and improving compile rate by 3.5% compared to similar agentic methods. The codebase, prompts and dataset will be made publicly available to support reproducibility and future research.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种混合智能体-物理架构，将基于知识的工程工具嵌入AI决策环路，通过显式物理验证生成更复杂且可靠的CAD设计。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM生成CAD时缺乏物理理解，无法确保工程设计的可靠性，而隐式学习物理规律的方法效果有限。
AI.method: 采用混合智能体-物理架构，将知识型工程工具嵌入AI智能体决策闭环中，通过负载案例分析、迭代规划、生成、评估和修改实现物理验证驱动设计。
AI.result: 结构复杂度提升4.2倍，编译成功率比同类智能体方法提高3.5%，生成了更复杂且经过物理验证的设计。
AI.conclusion: 显式嵌入物理验证工具到AI决策循环中，可有效提升生成CAD的物理可靠性和工程实用性。

title: Efficient Long-Context Modeling in Diffusion Language Models via Block Approximate Sparse Attention
summary: Diffusion Language Models (DLMs) enable globally coherent, bidirectional, and controllable text generation, offering advantages over traditional autoregressive LLMs, while scaling to ultra-long sequences remains costly. Many existing block-sparse attention methods select blocks by fixed sampling patterns over the high-resolution attention space, such as tail regions or anti-diagonal stripes. Such prior-driven sampling can miss salient tokens and introduce instability under distribution shifts. In this paper, we propose the Block Approximate Sparse Attention framework (BA-Att) with block-wise pre-downsampled operation, which identifies informative regions within a compact downsampled space, avoiding reliance on brittle positional priors. To analyze its theoretical behavior, we define an oracle post-downsample attention map and formalize the approximation error between pre- and post-downsample schemes. Based on this insight, we introduce a lightweight norm-sorting module and a covariance-compensated correction that approximates full covariance using diagonal QK variances, reducing computational complexity. Extensive experiments show that our operator achieves up to 6.95x acceleration over FlashAttention in attention computation, and maintains near full-attention performance at 50% sparsity across language models, multimodal language models, and video generation models, demonstrating strong efficiency and generalization.

AI.tldr: 本文提出BA-Att框架，通过块级预下采样操作在紧凑空间中识别重要区域，避免依赖位置先验，结合轻量级范数排序模块和协方差补偿校正，在注意力计算上实现高达6.95倍加速，并在50%稀疏度下保持接近全注意力的性能。
AI.motivation: 扩散语言模型在全局连贯、双向可控文本生成方面优于传统自回归LLM，但扩展到超长序列时计算成本高昂。现有块稀疏注意力方法基于固定采样模式（如尾部区域或反对角条纹）选择块，这种先验驱动的采样可能遗漏重要token，并在分布偏移下引入不稳定性。
AI.method: 提出BA-Att框架，包含块级预下采样操作在紧凑下采样空间中识别信息区域；定义后下采样注意力图作为oracle，形式化预/后下采样方案的近似误差；引入轻量级范数排序模块和协方差补偿校正，利用对角QK方差近似全协方差降低计算复杂度。
AI.result: 注意力计算相比FlashAttention实现高达6.95倍加速；在50%稀疏度下，在语言模型、多模态语言模型和视频生成模型上均保持接近全注意力的性能，展现强效率和泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: BA-Att通过预下采样策略有效避免了位置先验的局限性，在保持模型性能的同时显著加速了长序列场景下的注意力计算，具有良好的泛化性。

title: FAGER: Factually Grounded Evaluation and Refinement of Text-to-Image Models
comment: It was accepted for an oral presentation at the 2nd Workshop on the Evaluation of Generative Foundation Models (EVGENFM2026) at CVPR 2026. Total 8 pages (1 page for references). 5 figures
summary: Existing text-to-image (T2I) evaluation metrics mainly assess whether generated images align with information explicitly stated in the prompt, but often fail to capture factual requirements that are implicit, externally grounded, or identity-defining. As a result, they are not well suited for evaluating factual correctness in prompts involving scientific knowledge, historical facts, products, or culture-specific concepts. We propose FActually Grounded Evaluation and Refinement (FAGER), an agentic framework that evaluates whether generated images correctly reflect visually verifiable facts grounded in or implied by the prompt, while also providing actionable feedback for improvement. FAGER first constructs a structured factual rubric by combining LLM-based fact proposal with reference-guided visual fact extraction and verification, then converts the rubric into question-answer pairs for VLM-based evaluation. To validate FAGER as a factuality metric, we introduce a Factual A/B test, which measures whether a metric prefers factual reference images over corresponding generated images. Across five datasets spanning science, history, products, culture, and knowledge-intensive concepts, FAGER consistently outperforms prior metrics on this test. We further show that FAGER can be used to refine T2I outputs in a fully training-free manner, yielding substantial factuality gains across datasets.

AI.tldr: 提出了FAGER框架，通过构建结构化事实评估标准，结合LLM和VLM，对文本到图像生成中的事实正确性进行自动化评估与改进。
AI.motivation: 现有T2I评估指标主要关注提示词中明确陈述的信息，忽略了隐含的、外部知识支撑的或身份定义性的事实要求，难以评估涉及科学知识、历史事实、产品或文化概念等需要事实正确性的场景。
AI.method: FAGER框架首先利用LLM提出事实并结合参考引导的视觉事实提取与验证，构建结构化事实评估标准；然后将评估标准转化为问答对，供VLM进行评估。同时提出Factual A/B测试来衡量指标的事实性偏好能力。
AI.result: 在科学、历史、产品、文化及知识密集型概念等五个数据集上，FAGER在Factual A/B测试中一致优于先前指标。此外，FAGER可在无需训练的情况下用于优化T2I输出，显著提升事实正确性。
AI.conclusion: FAGER能够有效评估和改善文本到图像生成中的事实正确性，提供可操作的反馈，且方法无需重新训练模型。

title: Aero-World: Action-Conditioned Aerial Video Generation from Inertial Controls
summary: Foundation video models produce visually impressive results, but their use in embodied AI remains limited because they are primarily trained on natural language rather than low-level control signals. This limitation is especially pronounced for aerial flight, where motion occurs in unconstrained 6-DoF space and small errors in ego-motion can produce large trajectory drift. Generating aerial videos that follow fine-grained inertial actions can support scalable training and evaluation of aerial agents by providing a controllable proxy for real-world or expensive simulation data. To address this problem, we propose \textbf{Aero-World}, a method for converting a pretrained image-to-video diffusion model into a controllable aerial video generator. Aero-World injects sequences of translational acceleration and angular velocity into a pretrained latent diffusion transformer through an action-token stream. A frozen latent-space Physics Probe, trained independently on real video--IMU pairs, provides differentiable inertial-consistency supervision during LoRA finetuning while avoiding computationally expensive video decoding. We further propose \textbf{AeroBench}, a benchmark for evaluating whether generated drone videos adhere to low-level action signals. AeroBench uses Action Alignment Score (AAS) to measure agreement with commanded inertial actions and Physical Consistency Rate (PCR) to measure temporal motion stability. On AeroBench, Aero-World improves mean AAS from 57.7 to 63.6 over action-only finetuning and gives a stronger quality-control trade-off than AirScape, with lower FVD (596.5 vs. 1058.6), higher SSIM (0.595 vs. 0.505), and higher Flow-IMU correlation (0.44 vs. 0.20). These results suggest that frozen Physics Probe supervision is a practical mechanism for adapting pretrained video generators toward more action-aligned aerial motion.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Aero-World，通过动作标记流和冻结的物理探测器监督，将预训练的图像到视频扩散模型转换为可控的空中视频生成器，用于生成符合惯性动作信号的无人机视频。同时提出AeroBench基准测试，验证生成视频的动作对齐和物理一致性。实验表明，该方法在动作对齐和视频质量上均优于基线。
AI.motivation: 现有基础视频模型主要基于自然语言训练，缺乏对低层级控制信号的支持，在无人机飞行等6-DoF运动场景中，细粒度惯性动作指令难以被精确生成，导致轨迹漂移。为此，需要将视频生成模型适配到能跟随惯性动作信号的方向，以支持空中智能体的可扩展训练和评估。
AI.method: Aero-World将预训练的图像到视频扩散模型转化为可控空中视频生成器。核心包括：(1) 通过动作标记流将平移加速度和角速度序列注入潜在扩散Transformer；(2) 使用冻结的潜在空间物理探测器（Physics Probe），该探测器在真实视频-IMU对数据上独立训练，在LoRA微调期间提供可微的惯性一致性监督，避免昂贵的视频解码。同时提出AeroBench基准，使用动作对齐分数（AAS）和物理一致性率（PCR）进行评估。
AI.result: 在AeroBench上，Aero-World将平均AAS从57.7提升至63.6，相比AirScape在FVD（596.5 vs. 1058.6）、SSIM（0.595 vs. 0.505）和Flow-IMU相关性（0.44 vs. 0.20）上均显著更优，展示出更强的质量-控制权衡。
AI.conclusion: 冻结的物理探测器监督是一种将预训练视频生成器适配为更符合动作对齐的空中运动生成的有效且实用的机制。

title: LIFT and PLACE: A Simple, Stable, and Effective Knowledge Distillation Framework for Lightweight Diffusion Models
comment: 15 pages, 11 figure, 9 tables, To appear in CVPR 2026
summary: We demonstrate that in knowledge distillation for diffusion models, the teacher network's highly complex denoising process - stemming from its substantially larger capacity - poses a significant challenge for the student model to faithfully mimic. To address this problem, we propose a coarse-to-fine distillation framework with LInear FiTtingbased distillation (LIFT) and Piecewise Local Adaptive Coefficient Estimation (PLACE). First, LIFT decomposes the objective into a "coarse" alignment and a "fine" refinement. The student is then trained on coarse alignment before proceeding to hard refinement. Second, PLACE extends LIFT to address spatially non-uniform errors by partitioning outputs into error-based groups, providing locally adaptive guidance. Our experiments show that LIFT and PLACE is effective across diffusion spaces (image/latent), backbones (U-Net/DiT), tasks (unconditional/conditional), datasets, and even extends to flow-based models such as MMDiT (SD3). Furthermore, under extreme compression with a 1.3M-parameter student (only 1.6% of the teacher), conventional KD fails to provide sufficient guidance for stable training, with FID scores often degrading to 50-200+, but our method remains stably convergent and achieves an FID of 15.73.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种粗到细的扩散模型知识蒸馏框架（LIFT + PLACE），解决了教师网络因容量过大导致学生难以模仿的问题，在极端压缩下仍能稳定收敛，FID达15.73。
AI.motivation: 教师网络容量远大于学生网络，其高度复杂的去噪过程使学生难以忠实模仿，传统知识蒸馏在极端压缩下甚至导致训练发散（FID恶化至50-200+）。
AI.method: 提出LIFT（线性拟合蒸馏）将目标分解为粗对齐和细细化两个阶段，先让学生学习粗对齐再处理硬细化；提出PLACE（分段局部自适应系数估计）将输出按误差分组，提供局部自适应指导以处理空间非均匀误差。
AI.result: 在图像/隐空间、U-Net/DiT骨干、条件/无条件生成、多种数据集及流模型MMDiT（SD3）上均有效；在1.3M参数学生（仅为教师1.6%）的极端压缩下，传统KD发散（FID 50-200+），该方法稳定收敛并达到FID 15.73。
AI.conclusion: 所提粗到细蒸馏框架能有效缓解教师-学生容量差距带来的蒸馏困难，在极端压缩场景下仍保持稳定训练和良好生成质量，且具有良好的泛化性。

title: GeoMamba: A Geometry-driven MambaVision Framework and Dataset for Fine-grained Optical-SAR Object Retrieval
summary: Multi-source remote sensing enables complementary observation of ground objects, while cross-modal fine-grained object retrieval remains challenging, especially under unaligned optical and SAR conditions. Unlike conventional retrieval settings that rely on paired or spatially aligned samples, practical optical-SAR retrieval is affected by substantial modality discrepancy, speckle noise, and structural inconsistency, which limit robust cross-modal representation learning. To address this problem, we propose GeoMamba, a geometry-driven framework tailored for optical-SAR fine-grained retrieval. Specifically, GeoMamba introduces a Geometric Feature Injection (GFI) module that enhances cross-modal feature interaction and incorporates structural priors, thereby improving the robustness of SAR representations and promoting geometry-consistent feature learning. In addition, a Geometric Consistency Constraint (GCC) module, together with a Deep Supervision (DS) strategy, imposes hierarchical geometric constraints using classical operators, which helps preserve informative object structures during representation learning. We further construct a new dataset, FGOS-as, containing 11 aerospace and maritime categories for evaluating unaligned cross-modal fine-grained object retrieval in realistic remote sensing scenarios. Extensive experiments on FGOS-as demonstrate that GeoMamba outperforms existing methods, achieving 63.3% mAP and 77.0% Rank-1 accuracy in all-to-all retrieval setting.

AI.tldr: 本文提出GeoMamba框架，通过几何特征注入和几何一致性约束等模块，解决光学与SAR遥感图像之间的跨模态细粒度目标检索问题，在自建数据集FGOS-as上达到63.3% mAP和77.0% Rank-1的检索精度。
AI.motivation: 多源遥感数据虽能互补观测地物，但光学与SAR图像之间存在显著的模态差异、散斑噪声和结构不一致性，传统依赖配对或空间对齐样本的检索方法难以适用，亟需一种能处理非对齐条件下跨模态细粒度目标检索的方法。
AI.method: 提出GeoMamba框架，包含三个核心模块：(1) 几何特征注入(GFI)模块，增强跨模态特征交互并融入结构先验；(2) 几何一致性约束(GCC)模块，联合深度监督(DS)策略，利用经典算子施加层次化几何约束；(3) 构建了包含11个航空航天与海洋类别的FGOS-as数据集。
AI.result: 在FGOS-as数据集的全对全检索设置下，GeoMamba达到63.3% mAP和77.0% Rank-1准确率，优于现有方法。
AI.conclusion: GeoMamba通过几何驱动的跨模态特征学习有效提升了光学-SAR非对齐条件下的细粒度目标检索性能，验证了几何先验在缓解模态差异方面的有效性。

title: FlowErase-RL: Rethinking Concept Erasure as Reward Optimization in Flow Matching Models
summary: Recent advances in flow matching models have significantly improved text-to-image generation quality, but also introduce growing safety risks due to the generation of harmful or undesirable content. Existing concept erasure methods are either inference-time interventions with limited effectiveness or rely on supervised fine-tuning (SFT), which requires precisely aligned data and struggles with scalability and multi-concept settings. In this paper, we propose \emph{FlowErase-RL}, the first GRPO-based framework for concept erasure in flow matching models. We reformulate concept erasure as a reward optimization problem and introduce a \textbf{dynamic dual-path reward mechanism} that jointly optimizes (i) a Concept Erasure (CE) reward to suppress target concepts and (ii) a Non-target Space (NS) reward to preserve generative fidelity. The two reward paths are adaptively balanced during training via a performance-driven switching strategy, enabling stable optimization without explicit supervision. Extensive experiments on nudity, object, and artistic style erasure demonstrate that our method achieves state-of-the-art erasure performance while maintaining strong image quality and semantic alignment. Moreover, it exhibits robust resistance to adversarial attacks and scales effectively to multi-concept scenarios. Our results establish a new paradigm for safe and controllable generation in flow matching models.

AI.tldr: FlowErase-RL 是首个基于 GRPO 的流匹配模型概念擦除框架，通过动态双路径奖励机制联合优化目标概念抑制与生成保真度，在多种擦除任务中达到 SOTA 性能，且具备抗攻击与多概念扩展能力。
AI.motivation: 现有流匹配模型存在安全风险，而传统概念擦除方法（推理时干预或 SFT）效果有限、依赖对齐数据、难以扩展至多概念场景，亟需更高效的擦除框架。
AI.method: 将概念擦除重构为奖励优化问题，提出动态双路径奖励机制，包含概念擦除（CE）奖励与非目标空间（NS）奖励，并通过性能驱动的切换策略自适应平衡两个路径，无需显式监督。
AI.result: 在裸体、物体、艺术风格擦除任务上达到 SOTA 擦除性能，同时保持高质量图像生成与语义对齐，具备鲁棒的对抗攻击抵抗力和多概念场景扩展能力。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为流匹配模型的安全可控生成建立了新范式。

title: CPC-VAR:Continual Personalized and Compositional Generation in Visual Autoregressive Models
summary: Visual autoregressive (VAR) models have recently emerged as an efficient paradigm for text-to-image generation. Despite their strong generative capability, existing VAR-based personalization methods remain limited to static settings, failing to accommodate evolving user demands. In particular, sequential concept learning leads to severe catastrophic forgetting, while multi-concept synthesis often suffers from feature entanglement and attribute inconsistency. In this work, we present the first systematic study of continual personalized generation in VAR models. We identify two key challenges: (i) preserving previously learned concepts during sequential customization, and (ii) composing multiple personalized concepts in a controllable manner. To address these issues, we propose a unified framework with two core components. For continual single-concept learning, we introduce Gradient-based Concept Neuron Selection (GCNS), which identifies concept-relevant neurons and constrains only conflicting parameters across tasks, effectively mitigating forgetting without additional model expansion. For multi-concept synthesis, we propose a context-aware composition strategy that performs multi-branch feature modeling and localized cross-attention fusion guided by spatial conditions, enabling precise and disentangled concept composition. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method significantly improves performance in long-sequence continual personalization while achieving superior results in multi-concept image synthesis compared to existing baselines. These findings highlight the potential of VAR models for scalable and controllable personalized generation.

AI.tldr: 本文首次系统研究VAR模型中的持续个性化生成，提出统一框架解决顺序学习中的灾难性遗忘和多概念合成中的特征纠缠问题，通过梯度概念神经元选择和上下文感知组合策略实现可扩展的个性化生成。
AI.motivation: 现有VAR个性化方法局限于静态设置，无法满足用户不断变化的需求：顺序概念学习会导致严重灾难性遗忘，多概念合成存在特征纠缠和属性不一致问题。
AI.method: 提出统一框架包含两个核心组件：(1) 梯度概念神经元选择(GCNS)——识别概念相关神经元，仅约束跨任务的冲突参数，减轻遗忘；(2) 上下文感知组合策略——多分支特征建模和基于空间条件的局部交叉注意力融合，实现精准解耦的概念组合。
AI.result: 在长序列持续个性化任务中显著提升性能，在多概念图像合成中取得优于现有基线方法的结果。
AI.conclusion: 证明VAR模型在可扩展、可控的个性化生成方面具有巨大潜力。

title: Preferences Order, Ratings Anchor: From Fused Expert Aesthetic Ground Truth to Self-Distillation
summary: Pairwise preferences and pointwise ratings are the two dominant annotation protocols in image aesthetic assessment (IAA), yet existing benchmarks adopt only one, leaving their complementarity unmeasured under controlled conditions. We introduce PPaint, a matched dual-protocol benchmark in which 15 domain experts, 5 per category, annotate 150 Chinese paintings under both protocols across five aesthetic dimensions, collecting 45,900 pairwise expert judgments through a locally dense preference design alongside the matched ratings. The matched design reveals complementary strengths: preferences yield more consistent ordinal rankings, while ratings anchor the absolute score scale. Fusing both signals via two independent preference-to-score methods yields a fused expert ground truth on which the two constructions converge to nearly identical scores. The same preference-to-score principle extends to label-free VLM training. PSDistill converts VLM pairwise judgments into calibrated pseudo-scores via an Elo reference pool, and trains the same VLM with confidence-weighted ranking optimization to produce a single-pass aesthetic scorer. Trained on a single painting category, the distilled Qwen3-VL-8B improves mean SRCC from 0.504 to 0.709 across all three categories, outperforming all open-source baselines including the dedicated aesthetic model ArtiMuse and matching closed-source Gemini-3.1-Pro within 0.04 SRCC at single-pass inference cost, with cross-domain transfer further validated on APDDv2. We will release the full PPaint dataset and training code.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PPaint，一个匹配设计的美学评估双协议基准（成对偏好+点式评分），并开发PSDistill方法将偏好信号转化为校准伪分数，在单类别训练下实现跨类别0.709 SRCC，超越所有开源基线，接近闭源Gemini-3.1-Pro。
AI.motivation: 现有的图像美学评估基准只采用成对偏好或点式评分中的一种协议，缺少在受控条件下对两者互补性的量化研究。
AI.method: 1) 构建PPaint基准：15位专家（每类5人）对150幅中国画在5个美学维度上同时进行两种协议标注，共45,900个偏好判断。2) 提出PSDistill方法：通过Elo参考池将VLM的成对判断转化为校准伪分数，再用置信度加权排序优化训练VLM，使其成为单次前馈的美学评分器。
AI.result: 在单一绘画类别上训练的Qwen3-VL-8B，平均SRCC从0.504提升至0.709，超越所有开源基线（包括专用模型ArtiMuse），与闭源Gemini-3.1-Pro仅差0.04 SRCC，且在APDDv2上验证了跨域迁移能力。
AI.conclusion: 成对偏好和点式评分具有互补优势：偏好产生更一致的序数排名，评分锚定绝对分数尺度。将两者信号融合可获得更优的美学评估，且偏好信号可无标签地用于VLM训练。

title: Fast 4D Mesh Generation by Spatio-Temporal Attention Chains
summary:
4D mesh generation has recently emerged as a powerful paradigm for recovering dynamic 3D structure from videos, but existing methods remain slow, computationally expensive, and difficult to scale to longer sequences. We introduce a training-free approach that accelerates 4D mesh generation while improving temporal correspondence quality. Our key observation is that temporal correspondences emerge inside a 4D backbone long before its generated meshes become visually accurate. We exploit this with a general framework we call Spatio-Temporal Attention Chain which propagates information across space and time. Starting from vertices on an anchor mesh, the chain maps vertices to latent tokens. It then follows temporal correspondences in latent space, and recovers frame-specific vertices through latent-to-vertex attention. This design avoids expensive explicit matching while preserving anchor mesh details and thereby improving dynamic mesh geometry and temporal consistency.
  Compared to state-of-the-art, our method generates a 4D mesh in 9 seconds, achieving a $13\times$ speedup while producing higher-quality results. Moreover, our approach scales to videos up to $16\times$ longer without degrading mesh quality. Beyond generation, the improved correspondences enable competitive zero-shot performance on two downstream tasks: 2D object tracking and 4D tracking. We further show that our framework enables reliable camera estimation, a capability not supported by prior 4D mesh generation methods.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种无需训练的4D网格生成加速方法，通过时空注意力链在9秒内生成高质量4D网格，实现13倍加速，并支持更长的视频序列。
AI.motivation: 现有4D网格生成方法速度慢、计算成本高，难以扩展到长视频序列。
AI.method: 提出时空注意力链（Spatio-Temporal Attention Chain），从锚定网格顶点出发，映射到潜在token，沿时间对应关系传播，最后通过潜在-顶点注意力恢复帧特定顶点，避免显式匹配。
AI.result: 9秒生成4D网格，实现13倍加速；支持长达16倍以上的视频序列而不降低网格质量；在2D目标跟踪和4D跟踪下游任务上取得零样本竞争性能；支持相机估计。
AI.conclusion: 该方法在不牺牲质量的前提下大幅提升了4D网格生成的效率与可扩展性，并在多个下游任务中展现了良好的泛化能力。

title: Mechanisms of Object Localization in Vision-Language Models
summary: Visually-grounded language models (VLMs) are highly effective in linking visual and textual information, yet they often struggle with basic classification and localization tasks. While classification mechanisms have been studied more extensively, the processes that support object localization remain poorly understood. In this work, we investigate two representative families, LLaVA-1.5 and InternVL-3.5, using a suite of mechanistic interpretability tools, including token ablations, attention knockout, and causal mediation analysis. We find that localization is driven by a containerization mechanism in which object-aligned tokens define the spatial extent of the object, while the semantic arrangement of tokens within those boundaries is largely irrelevant to the predicted box. Only a very small set of attention heads mediates the causal effect for both classification and localization, concentrating in early-mid layers for LLaVA and mid-late layers for InternVL. The two tasks share some early processing but ultimately depend on largely distinct specialized heads. Overall, we provide the first layer- and head-level account of localization in VLMs, revealing narrow computational pathways that can guide future model design and grounding objectives.

AI.tldr: 本文通过机械可解释性工具分析了LLaVA-1.5和InternVL-3.5两种视觉语言模型，发现目标定位依赖于一种容器化机制，其中物体对齐的token定义了空间范围，而语义排列对预测框影响不大。分类和定位由少量不同的注意力头在特定层级中介，揭示了窄计算通路。
AI.motivation: 尽管视觉语言模型在链接视觉和文本信息方面表现出色，但在基础分类和定位任务上仍存在困难。分类机制已得到较多研究，但目标定位的支持过程仍知之甚少，因此需要深入探索。
AI.method: 使用token消融、注意力淘汰和因果中介分析等机械可解释性工具，对LLaVA-1.5和InternVL-3.5两种代表性模型进行系统性分析。
AI.result: 定位由容器化机制驱动：物体对齐token定义空间范围，token内部语义排列对预测框几乎无影响。分类和定位仅由极少量注意力头中介因果效应，分别集中在LLaVA的早期-中层和InternVL的中期-晚期层。两个任务共享部分早期处理，但最终依赖不同的专用头。
AI.conclusion: 首次提供VLM中定位的层级和头级解释，揭示了窄计算通路，可指导未来模型设计和接地目标优化。

title: Synergistic Foundation Models for Semi-Supervised Fetal Cardiac Ultrasound Analysis: SAM-Med2D Boundary Refinement and DINOv3 Semantic Enhancement
comment: Accepted to the ISBI 2026 Fetal HearT UltraSound Segmentation and Diagnosis (FETUS) Challenge
summary:
We present a semi-supervised framework for joint segmentation and classification of fetal cardiac ultrasound images. Built upon the EchoCare multi-task backbone, our method integrates SAM-Med2D for boundary refinement and leverages DINOv3 to enhance pseudo-label quality. We introduce view-specific hard masking along with a two-stage optimization strategy: an EMA phase to consolidate segmentation capabilities, followed by a Classification Fine-Tuning phase that freezes segmentation parameters and resets the classification head to recover classification performance without compromising segmentation gains.
  Evaluated on the FETUS 2026 leaderboard, our method achieves a Dice Similarity Coefficient at 79.99%, Normalized Surface Distance at 61.62%, and F1-score at 41.20%, validating the effectiveness of our approach for prenatal congenital heart disease screening. Source code is publicly available at: https://github.com/2826056177/zcst_fetus2026.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种半监督框架，用于胎儿心脏超声图像的联合分割与分类。基于EchoCare多任务骨干网络，集成SAM-Med2D进行边界优化，并利用DINOv3提升伪标签质量。通过视图特定硬掩码和两阶段优化策略（EMA阶段+分类微调阶段），在FETUS 2026榜单上DSC达79.99%，NSD达61.62%，F1达41.20%。
AI.motivation: 为了解决胎儿心脏超声图像中标注数据稀缺的问题，实现联合分割与分类，提升产前先天性心脏病筛查的准确性。
AI.method: 基于EchoCare多任务骨干，集成SAM-Med2D进行边界细化，利用DINOv3增强伪标签质量；引入视图特定硬掩码；采用两阶段优化：EMA阶段巩固分割能力，分类微调阶段冻结分割参数并重置分类头以恢复分类性能。
AI.result: 在FETUS 2026榜单上，Dice相似系数79.99%，归一化表面距离61.62%，F1分数41.20%。
AI.conclusion: 该方法有效验证了半监督框架在产前先天性心脏病筛查中的可行性，代码已开源。

title: Stitched Value Model for Diffusion Alignment
summary: For practical use, diffusion- or flow-based generative models must be aligned with task-specific rewards, such as prompt fidelity or aesthetic preference. That alignment is challenging because the reward is defined for clean output images, but the alignment procedure requires value function estimates at noisy intermediate latents. Existing methods resort to Tweedie-style or Monte Carlo approximations, trading off estimator bias against computational cost: Tweedie estimates are efficient but biased, while Monte Carlo estimates are more accurate but require expensive rollouts. A natural alternative would be a learned value function, but it remains an open question how to effectively train a strong and general value model specifically for noisy latents. Here, we propose StitchVM, a model stitching framework that efficiently transfers reward models pretrained for clean images to the noisy latent regime. StitchVM starts from an existing, truncated pixel-space reward model and attaches a frozen diffusion backbone to it as its head. From the pixel-space model, the resulting hybrid retains a carefully pretrained, robust reward capability; from the diffusion backbone, it inherits its native ability to handle noisy latents. The stitching procedure is exceptionally lightweight, e.g., stitching and finetuning CLIP ViT-L and SD 3.5 Medium takes only 10 GPU-hours. By lifting powerful pixel-space reward models to latent space, StitchVM opens up a new style of diffusion alignment: instead of rough, yet costly per-sample approximation of the value function, the correct function for the actual, noisy latents is constructed once and then amortized over many samples and iterations. We show that this approach yields improvements across a broad range of downstream steering and post-training methods: DPS becomes $3.2\times$ faster while halving peak GPU memory, and DiffusionNFT becomes $2.3\times$ faster.

AI.tldr: StitchVM提出了一种模型拼接框架，将预训练在干净图像上的奖励模型与冻结的扩散骨干网络结合，使其能够处理含噪隐空间特征，从而实现高效且低成本的扩散模型对齐。
AI.motivation: 扩散/流生成模型需要对任务特定奖励（如提示保真度、美学偏好）进行对齐，但奖励仅定义在干净输出图像上，而对齐过程需要在含噪中间隐变量上估计价值函数。现有Tweedie估计有偏、Monte Carlo估计计算昂贵，而直接学习面向含噪隐变量的价值函数仍是一个开放问题。
AI.method: StitchVM从现有截断的像素空间奖励模型出发，将冻结的扩散骨干网络作为其头部拼接上去。混合模型从像素空间部分保留了预训练的鲁棒奖励能力，从扩散骨干部分继承了处理含噪隐变量的原生能力。拼接过程极其轻量，例如拼接CLIP ViT-L和SD 3.5 Medium仅需10 GPU小时。
AI.result: 在下游引导和后训练方法上均有显著提升：DPS加速3.2倍且峰值GPU内存减半，DiffusionNFT加速2.3倍。
AI.conclusion: 通过将强大的像素空间奖励模型提升到隐空间，StitchVM开辟了新的扩散对齐范式：不再对每个样本进行粗糙且昂贵的价值函数近似，而是一次性构建面向实际含噪隐变量的正确价值函数，并在大量样本和迭代中摊销成本。

title: LaCoVL-FER: Landmark-Guided Contrastive Learning Network with Vision-Language Enhancement for Facial Expression Recognition
summary: Facial Expression Recognition (FER) in the wild is still challenging due to uncontrolled variations in pose, occlusion, and illumination. Most existing attention-based methods primarily rely on visual appearance cues, suffering from attention redundancy and instability, which limits their performance in complex scenarios. To address these issues, we propose a novel landmark-guided contrastive learning network with vision-language enhancement for FER (LaCoVL-FER), which integrates geometric priors from facial landmarks and semantic priors from a vision-language model. Specifically, a Landmark-Guided Adaptive Encoder (LGAE) is designed to introduce geometric priors through a Bi-branch Gated Cross Attention (BGCA) mechanism, which achieves adaptive fusion of landmark-based geometric and visual appearance features to produce expression-relevant features, thereby focusing on key facial regions and suppressing noise interference. In parallel, a Vision-Language Enhancement Strategy (VLES) is presented to leverage the expression-relevant features to refine the generalizable visual features extracted by the frozen pretrained CLIP image encoder, yielding expression-specific visual representations. Based on these representations, an Expression-Conditioned Prompting (ECP) mechanism is utilized to further adapt the textual features of fixed class-level prompts from the frozen pretrained CLIP text encoder, generating more instance-aware textual representations. These visual-textual representations are aligned as semantic priors to enhance the robustness and generalization of FER. Quantitative and qualitative experiments demonstrate that our LaCoVL-FER outperforms state-of-the-art methods on three representative real-world FER datasets, including RAF-DB, FERPlus, and AffectNet. The code is available at https://github.com/ylin06804/LaCoVL-FER.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种名为LaCoVL-FER的 landmark引导对比学习网络，融合面部几何先验与视觉语言语义先验，在三个真实世界FER数据集上超越当前最优方法。
AI.motivation: 野外表情识别因姿态、遮挡和光照变化而挑战重重，现有注意力方法依赖视觉外观特征，存在注意力冗余和不稳定问题，在复杂场景下性能受限。
AI.method: 提出LaCoVL-FER，包含三个核心组件：1) Landmark引导自适应编码器(LGAE)通过双分支门控交叉注意力(BGCA)融合几何与外观特征；2) 视觉语言增强策略(VLES)利用表情相关特征优化CLIP图像编码器的视觉特征；3) 表情条件提示(ECP)机制生成实例感知的文本表征，并通过视觉-文本表征对齐增强鲁棒性。
AI.result: 在RAF-DB、FERPlus和AffectNet三个代表性真实世界FER数据集上，定量和定性实验均表明LaCoVL-FER优于当前最先进方法。
AI.conclusion: 融合几何先验和语义先验可有效提升复杂场景下的表情识别性能，方法具有良好鲁棒性和泛化能力。

title: When Preference Labels Fall Short: Aligning Diffusion Models from Real Data
comment: ICML 2026 Camera Ready; Project Page: https://cwyxx.github.io/RealAlign
summary: Preference alignment aims to guide generative models by learning from comparisons between preferred and non-preferred samples. In practice, most existing approaches rely on preference pairs constructed from model-generated images. Such supervision is inherently relative and can be ambiguous when both samples exhibit artifacts or limited visual quality, making it difficult to infer what constitutes a truly desirable output. In this work, we investigate whether real data can serve as an alternative source of supervision for preference alignment. We adopt a data-centric perspective and study a curation strategy that treats real images as reference points and constructs preference signals by contrasting them with generated or perturbed samples, without requiring manually annotated preference pairs. Through empirical analysis, we show that real-data-based supervision provides effective guidance for aligning diffusion models and achieves performance comparable to existing preference-based methods. Our results suggest that real data offers a practical and complementary source of supervision for preference alignment and highlight directions of label-efficient alignment strategies. Code and models are available at https://cwyxx.github.io/RealAlign.

AI.tldr: 本文研究是否可以用真实数据替代人工标注的偏好对来对齐扩散模型，提出RealAlign方法，通过对比真实图像与生成/扰动图像构建偏好信号，实验表明该方法性能与现有偏好对齐方法相当。
AI.motivation: 现有偏好对齐方法依赖模型生成图像构建的偏好对，这种监督是相对的，当两个样本都存在伪影时难以判断什么是真正理想的输出。作者希望探索真实数据能否作为偏好对齐的替代监督源。
AI.method: 采用数据为中心的视角，将真实图像作为参考点，通过对比真实图像与生成图像或扰动图像来构建偏好信号，无需人工标注的偏好对。
AI.result: 基于真实数据的监督能够有效指导扩散模型的对齐，性能与现有基于偏好的方法相当。
AI.conclusion: 真实数据为偏好对齐提供了实用且互补的监督来源，为标签高效的齐策略指明了方向。

title: A Framework for Evaluating Zero-Shot Image Generation in Concept-based Explainability
comment: G. Astolfi, M. Bianchi, and R. Campi contributed equally
summary: Concept-based Explainable Artificial Intelligence (XAI) interprets deep learning models using human-understandable visual features (e.g., textures or object parts) by linking internal representations to class predictions, thereby bridging the gap between low-level image data and high-level semantics. A major challenge, however, is the reliance on large sets of labeled images to represent each concept, which limits scalability. In this work, we investigate the use of zero-shot Text-to-Image (T2I) generative models as a source of synthetic concept datasets for concept-based XAI methods. Specifically, we generate concepts using predefined prompts and evaluate their faithfulness to real ones through four complementary analyses: (1) comparing synthetic vs. real concept images via concept representation similarity; (2) evaluating their intra-similarity by comparing pairs of subsets of the same concept with progressively increasing size; (3) evaluating their performance for downstream explanation tasks using relevant class images; (4) evaluating how removing a concept from tested class images affects explanations of generated concepts. While current T2I generative models promise a shortcut to concept-based XAI, our study highlights challenges and raises open questions about the use of synthetic data generated by zero-shot pipelines in model analyses. The resulting dataset is available at https://github.com/DataSciencePolimi/ZeroShot-T2I-Concepts.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了使用零样本文本到图像生成模型合成概念数据集用于概念性可解释人工智能，并通过四种分析评估了合成概念与真实概念的忠实度，发现当前生成模型虽能作为捷径但存在挑战。
AI.motivation: 概念性XAI依赖大量标注图像来表征每个概念，这限制了可扩展性，因此需要探索更高效的概念数据获取方式。
AI.method: 使用预定义提示词生成合成概念，并通过四种分析进行评估：(1)合成与真实概念图像的表征相似性；(2)同概念子集间的内部相似性；(3)下游解释任务的性能；(4)移除概念对解释的影响。
AI.result: 当前T2I生成模型虽为概念性XAI提供了捷径，但合成数据的使用存在挑战和开放性问题。
AI.conclusion: 零样本T2I生成模型可用于合成概念数据集，但在模型分析中使用合成数据仍需谨慎，数据已开源。

title: Eyes on VLM: Benchmarking Gaze Following and Social Gaze Prediction in Vision Language Models
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) have rapidly evolved into general-purpose multimodal reasoners with strong zero-shot generalization. In this context, VLMs could greatly benefit the analysis of human gaze and attention, a central task in human behavior understanding that requires reasoning about the physical scene as well as the activity, interactions, and social context. However, the extent to which VLMs can reliably understand human gaze and related attentional behaviors remains largely unexplored. In this work, we present EyeVLM, a systematic evaluation framework for gaze understanding in VLMs across two complementary dimensions: tasks and models. To assess gaze understanding capabilities, we focus on two core tasks. The first, gaze following, i.e., predicting the 2D location where a person is looking, has a geometric and visual processing focus, requiring a precise understanding of the human face, attention direction, 3D scene structure, and spatial grounding of attended targets. The second, social gaze prediction, requires social and relational reasoning over multi-person interactions (e.g., mutual gaze and shared attention), and may benefit more from the LLM semantic reasoning capabilities within VLMs. Regarding models, EyeVLM evaluates these tasks in two ways: a zero-shot setting with a diverse set of state-of-the-art open- and closed-source VLMs, exploring different prompting strategies; and a fine-tuning approach based on task-specific QA pairs, studying the impact of model scale and data scale. As benchmarks, we rely on existing gaze understanding datasets and perform a systematic comparison with state-of-the-art purely visual models. Overall, our results show that current VLMs lack precise gaze understanding capabilities. While standard training helps reduce the gap with visual models, significant improvements are still needed.

AI.tldr: 本文提出EyeVLM框架，系统评估视觉语言模型（VLM）在视线跟随和社交视线预测两项核心任务上的表现。研究发现，当前VLM缺乏精确的视线理解能力，即使在微调后仍与纯视觉模型存在显著差距。
AI.motivation: VLM作为通用多模态推理器，有潜力用于人类视线和注意力分析，但目前缺乏对这一能力的系统性评估。
AI.method: 构建EyeVLM评估框架，从任务维度（视线跟随、社交视线预测）和模型维度（零样本提示、微调QA对）两方面系统评估多种开源和闭源VLM。
AI.result: 当前VLM在视线理解任务上表现不足，缺乏精确的视觉空间理解能力；标准微调虽能缩小与纯视觉模型的差距，但仍需大幅改进。
AI.conclusion: VLM当前不具备精确的视线理解能力，与专用视觉模型差距明显，该领域仍有很大提升空间。

title: Landscape-Awareness for Geometric View Diffusion Model
summary: Accurate camera viewpoint estimation under sparse-view conditions remains challenging, particularly in two-view scenarios. Recent approaches leverage diffusion models such as Zero123 to synthesize novel views conditioned on relative viewpoint, showing promising results when repurposed for viewpoint estimation via optimization with MSE loss. However, existing methods often suffer from nonconvex loss landscape with numerous local minima, making them sensitive to initialization and reliant on naive multistart strategies. We analyze these optimization challenges and visualize failure cases, showing that geometric ambiguities, such as symmetry and self-similarity, can mislead gradient-based updates toward incorrect viewpoints. To address these limitations, we propose a score-based method that reshapes the optimization landscape to guide updates toward the ground-truth viewpoint, followed by a refinement stage using a viewpoint-conditioned diffusion model. Experiments show that our method improves convergence, reduces reliance on brute-force sampling, and achieves competitive accuracy with higher sample-efficiency.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种基于分数的视角估计方法，通过重塑优化景观和条件扩散模型精炼，提高了稀疏视角下（尤其是双视角）相机视角估计的准确性和采样效率。
AI.motivation: 现有基于扩散模型（如Zero123）的视角估计方法存在非凸损失函数、大量局部极小值、对初始化敏感、依赖暴力多起点策略等问题，几何歧义（对称性和自相似性）会导致梯度更新被误导至错误视角。
AI.method: 提出两阶段方法：1）基于分数的方法重塑优化景观，引导更新朝向真实视角；2）使用视角条件扩散模型进行精炼。
AI.result: 改进了收敛性能，减少了对暴力采样的依赖，以更高的采样效率达到了具有竞争力的精度。
AI.conclusion: 该方法有效解决了视角估计中的非凸优化和几何歧义问题，在稀疏视角条件下实现了更高效、更准确的相机视角估计。

title: Structured Layout Priors for Robust Out-of-Distribution Visual Document Understanding
comment: 18 pages, 7 figures. Main text: 9 pages (4 figures); Appendix: 9 pages (3 figures)
summary: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) parse documents end-to-end but frequently break down on layouts unlike those seen in training. We attribute this to a two-hop bottleneck: before the decoder can extract content (Hop 2), it must first classify and localize the enclosing layout entity (Hop 1), and when the first hop fails the second collapses into omissions, malformed structure, or autoregressive repetition. We pre-resolve Hop 1 outside the decoder by running a lightweight RT-DETR detector, serializing its outputs in the parser's native DocTags vocabulary, and injecting them into the prompt alongside the full page image. Unlike analyze-then-parse approaches that crop the page, or prior prompt-level priors written in plain text, our prior shares the decoder's generation space and leaves the global image in view as a fallback when detections are noisy. On a 10k-page structural out-of-distribution benchmark, markdown F1 rises from $0.37$ to $0.92$; on the Chinese subset of OmniDocBench, table TEDS rises from $0.01$ to $0.36$; and on the 26k-page ViDoRe V3 benchmark, infinite-loop decoding failures drop across every industrial domain tested. These gains cost $15\%$ wall-clock latency and a median of $74$ prompt tokens, with no architectural change to the base VLM. An attention-level analysis further reveals a bimodal phase shift in which the decoder attends to injected layout tokens when emitting structure and to image patches when emitting content, consistent with the two-hop bottleneck being alleviated. Model weights will be released to support reproducibility.

AI.tldr: 本文通过向VLM解码器外部的轻量级检测器注入布局先验，解决了VLM在OOD布局上的两跳瓶颈问题，使markdown F1从0.37提升至0.92，解码无限循环大幅减少，且无需改变模型架构。
AI.motivation: VLMs在遇到训练中未见过的布局时性能急剧下降，作者归因于两跳瓶颈：解码器必须先完成布局实体的分类与定位（第一跳）才能提取内容（第二跳），第一跳失败时第二跳随之崩溃。
AI.method: 在解码器外部用轻量级RT-DETR检测器预解决第一跳问题，将其输出序列化为DocTags词汇注入提示中，同时保留完整页面图像作为检测噪声时的备选方案。该先验与解码器共享生成空间，不同于裁剪页面或纯文本先验的方法。
AI.result: 在10k页结构OOD基准上，markdown F1从0.37提升至0.92；OmniDocBench中文子集上table TEDS从0.01提升至0.36；26k页ViDoRe V3基准上各工业领域解码无限循环失败均大幅下降。代价仅为15%延迟增加和约74个token。
AI.conclusion: 通过外部检测器注入布局先验能有效缓解VLMs的两跳瓶颈，注意力分析显示解码器在输出结构时关注注入的布局token、输出内容时关注图像块，验证了该方法的作用机制。

title: Passive Construction Site Safety Monitoring via Persona-Scaffolded Adversarial Chain-of-Thought VLM Verification
comment: 10 pages, 4 figures. First place, Ironsite.ai Spatial Intelligence Hackathon, University of Maryland, February 2026. Code available at https://github.com/ananthsriram1/ironsite-hackathon-project-safety_assistant
summary: Construction remains the deadliest industry sector in the United States, with 1,055 fatal worker injuries recorded in 2023, and the majority preventable. Existing monitoring approaches are expensive, require real-time human operators, or address only a narrow subset of violations. This paper presents a passive, end-of-shift construction safety monitoring pipeline processing video from POV body-worn and fixed wall-mounted cameras through a three-stage architecture: (1) fine-tuned YOLO11 for primary PPE and hazard detection, (2) SAM 3 for segmentation refinement and worker deduplication, and (3) Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct with a method-prompted, persona-scaffolded three-pass adversarial chain-of-thought protocol for compliance verification and hallucination control. The principal contribution is the Stage 3 prompt design: professional persona backstories following the method-actor framing drive an observed 12% precision improvement over single-pass prompting in an informal three-author review of the 12-video Ironsite development corpus, with the largest gains on hallucination-prone violation categories. Structural message isolation enforces observational independence between a generator, discriminator, and reconciliation pass governed by asymmetric rules encoding priors about human observation versus automated detection reliability. The system maps violations to OSHA standards, performs REBA-inspired ergonomic risk scoring from pose keypoints, and produces per-worker safety reports with timestamped evidence. An evaluation harness is released for future reproduction.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种端到班的被动式施工安全监控管线，通过YOLO11+SAM3+Qwen3-VL三阶段架构处理穿戴式和固定摄像头视频，采用创新的三遍对抗链式思维提示协议进行合规验证，在12个视频的验证集上相比单次提示提升了12%的精度。
AI.motivation: 美国建筑业仍是致死率最高的行业（2023年1055人死亡，多数可预防），现有监控方法成本高、需实时人工操作或仅覆盖少数违规类型，缺乏一种被动、低成本、全面的端到班安全监测方案。
AI.method: 三阶段管线：（1）微调YOLO11进行PPE和危险物初级检测；（2）SAM 3进行分割优化和工人去重；（3）Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct采用方法提示、角色框架的三遍对抗链式思维协议（生成器-判别器-协调器，非对称规则编码人类观察与自动检测的先验可靠性差异）进行合规验证与幻觉控制。此外还进行OSHA标准映射、REBA启发的工效学风险评分，生成带时间戳证据的工人安全报告。
AI.result: 在12个视频的Ironsite开发集上，三作者非正式评审表明：Stage 3提示设计（专业角色背景+方法演员框架）相比单次提示提升了12%的精度，尤其在易产生幻觉的违规类别上提升最大。发布了评估工具以便复现。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出的被动式端到班安全监控管线通过精心设计的对抗链式思维提示协议有效提升了违规检测精度，为低成本、全自动的施工安全监测提供了可行方案，但仍需在更大规模数据集上验证。

title: Structural Energy Guidance for View-Consistent Text-to-3D Generation
comment: arXiv admin note: substantial text overlap with arXiv:2508.16917
summary: Text-to-3D generation based on diffusion models often suffers from the Janus problem, leading to inconsistent geometry across viewpoints. This work identifies viewpoint bias in 2D diffusion priors as the main cause and proposes Structural Energy-Guided Sampling (SEGS), a training-free and plug-and-play framework to improve multi-view consistency. SEGS constructs a structural energy in the PCA subspace of U-Net features and injects its gradient into the denoising process. It can be easily integrated into SDS/VSD pipelines without retraining. Experiments show that SEGS reduces the Janus Rate by about 10% on average and improves View-CS scores across multiple baselines, including DreamFusion, Magic3D, and LucidDreamer. This method effectively alleviates viewpoint artifacts while preserving appearance fidelity, providing a flexible solution for high-quality text-to-3D content generation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SEGS方法，通过在U-Net特征的PCA子空间中构建结构能量并注入梯度到去噪过程，无需训练即可缓解文本到3D生成中的Janus问题，将Janus率降低约10%。
AI.motivation: 文本到3D生成中广泛存在的Janus问题导致多视图几何不一致，现有方法效果有限，作者识别出2D扩散先验中的视角偏差是根本原因。
AI.method: 提出结构能量引导采样（SEGS）：在U-Net特征的PCA子空间中构建结构能量，将其梯度注入到SDS/VSD的去噪过程中，无需重新训练，即插即用。
AI.result: 在DreamFusion、Magic3D、LucidDreamer等多个基线方法上，Janus率平均降低约10%，View-CS分数提升，同时保持外观保真度。
AI.conclusion: SEGS有效缓解视角伪影，是一种灵活、无需训练的高质量文本到3D生成解决方案。

title: GoTTA be Diverse: Rethinking Memory Policies for Test-Time Adaptation
summary: Test-time adaptation (TTA) enables a pre-trained model to adapt online to an unlabeled test stream under distribution shift. While most TTA research focuses on the adaptation objective, practical streams also depend critically on the memory used to select which test samples drive adaptation. Existing memory mechanisms are usually evaluated as components of specific TTA algorithms, making it difficult to isolate which memory design choices matter and when they matter.
